name: [OPNsense] IPS - Blocked Packet Detected
description: Triggers when Suricata IPS drops/blocks a packet. Requires IPS mode enabled on OPNsense (Services > Intrusion Detection > IPS Mode).
author: OPNsense SOC Team
note:
## IPS Blocked Packet

Suricata IPS modunda paket dusurdu. event.action blocked olan eventleri arar.

### Kontrol
- rule.name alani saldiri imzasini gosterir
- source.ip kaynak saldirgan IP
- Services > Intrusion Detection > Alerts ekranini kontrol et

name: [OPNsense] IPS - SQL Injection Attempt
description: Triggers when Suricata detects SQL injection patterns (ET Open sql/web_server rules) targeting the Apache server on port 80.
author: OPNsense SOC Team
query: event.module: "suricata" and (rule.name: *SQL* or rule.name: *sqli* or rule.name: *UNION* or rule.category: "Web Application Attack")
note:
## SQL Injection

### Dogrulama
1. source.ip adresini kontrol et
2. destination.port 80 ise Apache hedef
3. rule.name imzayi gosterir
4. OPNsense IPS modunda ise event.action blocked olur

name: [OPNsense] IPS - Port Scan Detected
description: Triggers when Suricata detects reconnaissance scanning (Nmap, Nikto, dirb, etc.) against OPNsense WAN interface.
author: OPNsense SOC Team
query: event.module: "suricata" and (rule.name: *SCAN* or rule.name: *Nmap* or rule.name: *nikto* or rule.category: "Attempted Information Leak")
note:
## Port Scan Detection

Threshold: ayni source.ip'den 5 dakikada 5+ scan eventi.

### Dogrulama
- nmap -sS veya nmap -sV kaynakliysa normal pentest olabilir
- Nikto/dirb ise web kesfine gecilmis demektir

name: [OPNsense] IPS - Web Application Attack on Apache
description: Triggers on LFI, RFI, path traversal, Shellshock or XSS attempts targeting port 80 (Apache on LAN). Requires port forwarding WAN:80 -> LAN:80.
author: OPNsense SOC Team
query: event.module: "suricata" and destination.port: 80 and (rule.category: "Web Application Attack" or rule.name: *LFI* or rule.name: *RFI* or rule.name: *traversal* or rule.name: *shellshock* or rule.name: *XSS*)
false_positives: Web application scanners in authorized tests
note:
## Apache Web Attack

### On Kosul
OPNsense'de WAN:80 -> LAN Apache:80 port forwarding tanimli olmali.

### Adimlar
1. source.ip kaynak saldirgan
2. rule.name hangi vektoru gosterir (LFI/RFI/XSS)
3. Apache access loglarini kontrol et: /var/log/apache2/access.log

name: [OPNsense] IPS - Brute Force on Management UI (port 8080)
description: Triggers on repeated login attempts or brute force signatures targeting OPNsense web UI on port 8080.
author: OPNsense SOC Team
note:
## OPNsense Web UI Brute Force

Threshold: ayni source.ip'den 5 dakikada 10+ istek port 8080'e.

### Acil Adimlar
1. source.ip adresini OPNsense Firewall'da manuel blokla
2. Firewall > Rules > WAN > block source.ip
3. OPNsense System > Log Files > General kontrol et

name: [OPNsense] IPS - Critical Severity Alert (Severity 1)
description: Triggers on any Suricata alert with severity 1 (highest priority). Typically indicates confirmed exploit, targeted attack or high-confidence IOC match.
author: OPNsense SOC Team
note:
## Severity 1 Alert

Suricata kural setlerinde severity 1 en kritik siniftir.
Genellikle: exploit confirmation, known malware C2, ransomware pattern.

### Hemen Yap
1. source.ip derhal blokla
2. rule.name imzasini arastir
3. Etkilenen sistemleri izole et

name: [OPNsense] IPS - Exploit or Shellcode Attempt
description: Triggers when Suricata detects shellcode delivery, exploit kit activity or known CVE exploitation (e.g. EternalBlue, Log4Shell).
author: OPNsense SOC Team
query: event.module: "suricata" and (rule.name: *shellcode* or rule.name: *exploit* or rule.name: *EternalBlue* or rule.name: *Log4* or rule.category: "Executable Code was Detected")
note:
## Exploit / Shellcode

### Dogrulama
1. rule.name ve rule.category alanlarina bak
2. Payload analizi icin Suricata pcap loglarini kontrol et
3. Hedef sistemi derhal izole et

name: [OPNsense] IPS - C2 or Trojan Traffic Detected
description: Triggers when Suricata detects command-and-control beaconing, reverse shells or trojan communication patterns (ET Open trojan/C2 rule categories).
author: OPNsense SOC Team
query: event.module: "suricata" and (rule.category: "A Network Trojan was Detected" or rule.name: *trojan* or rule.name: *C2* or rule.name: *Reverse* or rule.name: *beacon* or rule.name: *RAT*)
note:
## C2 / Trojan Traffic

### Acil Adimlar
1. source.ip ve destination.ip her ikisini de blokla
2. LAN tarafinda etkilenmis host var mi kontrol et
3. DNS sorgularini incele: dns.question.name alani
4. Ilgili sistemi network'ten izole et

name: [OPNsense] Firewall - Block Action Detected
description: Triggers when OPNsense pf firewall explicitly blocks a connection. Source is filterlog (not Suricata). Useful for firewall rule audit.
author: OPNsense SOC Team
false_positives: Normal firewall block activity from default deny rules
note:
## Firewall Block

Bu kural Suricata degil filterlog kaynaklidir (event.module: opnsense).
Firewall kural eslesmeleri icin kullanilir.

### Kontrol
- rule.id hangi pf kuralinin tetikledigini gosterir
- source.ip ve destination.port incele

name: [OPNsense] Firewall - Suspicious TCP Scan Flags
description: Triggers on NULL, FIN or XMAS TCP scan flag combinations detected by Logstash pipeline tcp_flags analysis in filterlog events.
author: OPNsense SOC Team
query: event.module: "opnsense" and (tags: "tcp_null_scan" or tags: "tcp_fin_scan" or tags: "tcp_xmas_scan")
note:
## TCP Scan Flag Detection

Logstash pipeline tcp_flags analizi ile etiketlenir.
NULL scan: 0x000, FIN scan: 0x001, XMAS scan: 0x029

### Logstash Tag Kontrolu
tags alani tcp_null_scan, tcp_fin_scan veya tcp_xmas_scan icermeli.
